python_options.description: Class-aware min-fee floor (PPM) for channels classified saturated (outbound >= 85% of capacity) or source. Applied only when set BELOW revenue-ops-min-fee-ppm; 0 (default) allows true cheap egress on saturated edges. Cost-recovery floors still apply. Flow-aware exemption: high-local channels whose 7d flow is balanced at healthy turnover (self-refilling routers the discount cannot drain) keep the normal min-fee-ppm floor.
python_options.name: revenue-ops-min-fee-ppm-saturated

python_options.description: Maximum fee ceiling in PPM (default: 2000)
python_options.name: revenue-ops-max-fee-ppm

python_options.description: How to price relative to neighbor-median fee. "undercut" (default): price below the median to win volume. "match": target the median, no undercut. "premium": price above the median using the same per-corridor weight that would otherwise undercut. Use "premium" in inelastic-demand markets to maximize revenue per forward. "competition_aware": apply the median-undercut ONLY when a competitor is priced at or below DTS's target; preserve DTS when we're already below every competitor (undercut would otherwise drag fees down against an inelastic market).
python_options.name: revenue-ops-market-fee-mode

python_options.description: Base-fee policy (Upgrade A, 2026-04-22). "off" (default) and "adaptive" are equivalent: every channel gets the internal base fee default of 0 msat (the per-role split was retired; there is no revenue-ops-base-fee-msat option).
python_options.name: revenue-ops-base-fee-policy

python_options.description: Minimum competitor count for neighbor_median computation (default: 2). The median is used by market-fee-mode (undercut/match/premium/competition_aware); below this threshold the helper returns None and the market-fee-mode branch is skipped. Prod nodes with dense gossip may prefer 3.
python_options.name: revenue-ops-neighbor-median-min-competitors

python_options.description: Deprecated no-op compatibility setting; minimum-profit gating is enforced by the sats-EV gate and revenue-ops-rebalance-hold-margin (default: 10)
python_options.name: revenue-ops-rebalance-min-profit

python_options.description: Local ratio below which a destination bypasses the channel-level rebalance cooldown (Phase 3, default: 0.10; 0 disables)
python_options.name: revenue-ops-rebalance-emergency-local-ratio

python_options.description: Drift since last successful rebalance that bypasses the cooldown (Phase 3, default: 0.30; 0 disables)

python_options.description: Minimum final_score in SATS of expected net value a priced pair must clear or it is rejected as below_hold_margin (Phase 4, default: 0.0)

python_options.description: Per-pair fee budget = max(dest capex, ceil(amount * ppm / 1M)). Decouples per-rebalance fee from capex bootstrap (Iter1, default: 1000 = 0.1% of amount; 0 disables)
